Privacy Policy

This policy describes how Arcway Operations processes information for creator-controlled TikTok publishing and, only when separately approved and enabled, TikTok Business customer care.

Information we process

For account connection and publishing, we process the TikTok account identifier, display name, granted scopes, encrypted access and refresh tokens, creator posting options, uploaded media, captions, disclosure choices, approval records, publishing status and security audit records. If Business Messaging is enabled, we process customer sender identifiers, conversation and message identifiers, message type, message text and timestamps received from TikTok or requested by an authorized operator. For owned-post comments, we may process video and comment identifiers, comment text, author identifiers and update actions. We do not receive or store the account owner's TikTok password.

How information is used

Publishing information is used to identify the selected account, validate media and posting choices, display an exact preview, submit owner-approved content, report status, prevent duplicate actions and investigate failures. Customer-message and comment information is used to notify an authorized human operator, display the relevant conversation or comment, and send only the reply that the operator explicitly directs. The service does not send TikTok customer messages to an AI model and does not automatically compose or send customer replies.

Storage and security

Authorization tokens are encrypted at rest on a private operator-controlled server. TikTok account records, publishing tasks and media are stored separately from Facebook data. TikTok webhook signatures are verified before events are processed. Customer message and comment contents are not written to the TikTok service database; only minimal event identifiers and hashes used to prevent duplicate processing are retained there. Secrets are excluded from application logs, screenshots, audit text and AI model prompts. Access is limited to authorized operators.

Sharing

Information is exchanged with TikTok through the Content Posting API or TikTok API for Business only as needed for the capability the account owner authorized. If Business Messaging or comment notifications are enabled, relevant content is delivered to the single allowlisted Telegram operator chat configured for the service; Telegram processes that copy under its own terms and privacy policy. We do not sell personal information or use TikTok customer messages for advertising profiles.

Retention

OAuth state is short-lived. Publishing tasks, approval records, working media, minimal webhook deduplication records and operational audit records are retained only as needed to deliver the service, prevent duplicates and resolve failures. TikTok customer message and comment contents are not retained in the TikTok service database, but copies intentionally delivered to the authorized Telegram chat remain subject to that chat's retention and deletion settings. Revoked or expired tokens are no longer used.

Your choices

You may revoke access from TikTok, stop using the service, or request deletion of stored TikTok connection data. See the data deletion instructions.

Contact

For privacy questions or requests, email developer@bgmyangon.com.
